_note: Question pack 3: real items researched on 2026-10-18. Rule: only real prices (what something sells or sold for), never averages or medians.

questions.prompt: How much is a rotisserie chicken at Costco?
questions.context: The whole rotisserie chicken at a U.S. Costco warehouse, 2026.
questions.imageAlt: Illustration of a golden rotisserie chicken in a clear plastic container
questions.explanation: Costco has sold its rotisserie chicken for $4.99 since it was introduced in 1994. The only time it went up ($5.99) was during the Great Recession.

source.title: The One And Only Time Costco Raised Its Rotisserie Chicken Price
source.excerpt: It has been consistently priced at $4.99 since it was first put on the shelves in 1994.

questions.prompt: How much did 'Stan', a Tyrannosaurus rex skeleton, sell for at auction?

questions.prompt: How much did Facebook pay to buy Instagram in 2012?
